Usage: ocfl diff [flags]

Show changed files between versions of an object

Flags:
  -h, --help                 Show context-sensitive help.
      --root=STRING          The prefix/directory of the OCFL storage root used
                             for the command ($OCFL_ROOT)
      --debug                enable debug log messages

  -i, --id=STRING            The id for object to diff
  -v, --versions=-1,0,...    Object versions to compare, separated by commas.
                             0 refers to HEAD, negative numbers match versions
                             before HEAD.
